transitions.notes: CHANGE: Added +1.5 dB gain hump. Deep Style tail declining (RMS 0.265->0.250) + exp fade midpoint dip. Foss hum is low-harmonic so 4A->6A gap (2 steps) is masked.

CHANGES: (1) eq_ramp_power 0.33->0.5 — slower LP open, keeps Alone's 9B synth tamed longer during 3A->9B gap (6 Camelot steps). (2) +2.5 dB gain hump — both tracks in quiet zones during overlap (Foss tail RMS 0.155, Alone breakdown RMS 0.187).
NO CHANGE. BPM jump 123->126. Clean cut is correct.
NO TRANSITION CHANGE. Outgoing hold + LP ramp is correct. Otono gain_db +1.0 compensates for it being the quietest track.
NO TRANSITION CHANGE. 3-band incoming + exp p=6 is well-designed. Otono +1.0 dB gain_db narrows the 1.3 dB LUFS gap.
CHANGES: (1) 3-band power 3->2 — LD already naturally decaying (RMS 0.335->0.135), so gentler rolloff prevents premature disappearance. (2) +1.5 dB gain hump for the equal_power midpoint dip.
NO TRANSITION CHANGE. Automation is meticulously tuned. Quivver gain_db +1.0 fixes the 1.6 dB LUFS gap — the most impactful single gain correction in the set.
NO CHANGE. Still flagged for pro feedback. Bassline clash unresolvable with current tools.

CHANGE: Added LP 1000 on incoming Pink Skye. The 4-step Camelot gap (1A->9A) means PS highs clash with BTB mids above 500 Hz. LP tames PS highs during overlap while the fill distraction anchor still punches through (percussion-heavy, not affected by LP).
NO CHANGE. Already measured flat to -0.3 dB. Gain_db corrections on PS (0) and Daylight (-0.5) tighten the chain.
